course_review/1.card_source: golfify (pars and hole order match the OSM hole ways; OpenGolfAPI back-nine yardages differ and look like an older card)
course_review/1.summary: Routing, pars and card are right. Only two Blue tees are wrong (11, 18). Holes 6-9 and 12-15 have no OSM fairway/green, so those CHECKs are mostly spurious (picks land on visible fairway; the estimated par-3 greens sit on the real greens). osm_supplement.geojson adds blue-tagged tee boxes for 11 and 18.
